description: Dawn Star is building an interactive space mission simulation game that puts players in the shoes of aerospace engineers and mission directors. Our goal is to make real orbital mechanics, payload trade-offs, and resource management intuitive, strategic, and fun, where every design choice impacts mission survival and scientific return.
summary: our project is about making a 2d video game about artemis III. the game is about an astronaut who keeps the spaceship stable until the spaceship reaches HSL base. the astronaut make some missions and minigames to complete the quests from the leader of the ship.
details: the game starts with an astronaut called jacop, jacop has been chosen to go on a spaceship for the artemis III expedition. while they are on the ship, there are some issues like oxygen loss, team fatigue or power problems which jacop should solve it before they reach the HSL base. at the end of the game jacop success and the ship is ready to land on the HSL base.
